brief:
Palestinian groups opposed to Hamas have been accused of playing a role in Israel's military operations in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The Israeli-backed militias are said to be expanding their operational footprint, drawing scrutiny over their involvement in the territory's security landscape.

The accusations raise questions about the role of these anti-Hamas factions in the broader conflict and their relationship with Israeli forces conducting operations in the enclave.

title: Israeli-backed Palestinian militias expand Gaza operations amid accusations
